title: Reconstruction from Milnor K-theory modulo the characteristic
main_claim: For finitely generated K/k, L/l over algebraically closed fields of char p with trdeg >= 2, the map from field isomorphisms (K,k) -> (L,l) to Lambda-linear isomorphisms V_K -> V_L (V = F^x/F^xp) that carry Steinberg relations onto Steinberg relations, taken modulo F_p^x, is a bijection.
coverage: Read all 5 sections in full and checked each proof line by line. Lemma 2.1: [F:F^p]=p^d via the Frobenius tower. Lemma 2.2: degree-p adjunction, the product rule for the Euler derivations (exponents mod p), the eigenvector characterization, C(s_j)∩C(s_k)=C. Lemma 2.3: the pairing beta kills [f]⊗[1-f] because D(1-f)=-Df, and sends {s,t} to 1. Lemma 2.4: affine symbol. Prop 3.1: delta=D_X+D_Y kills Y/X; delta'=B_X D_X+B_Y D_Y kills V/U and fixes U and V; gives q_X+q_Y=1 and A_X q_X+A_Y q_Y=0; q_X, q_Y nonzero; delta q_X=0 by commutation; matching eigenvalues give A_X=c_X X^m and A_Y=c_Y Y^m; integration identity D_X(X^n+c_X X^p)/(X^n+c_X X^p)=n/(1+c_X X^m) with n=p-m; the uniqueness computation A_X=h/(jX^r) forces r=n. Sec 4: H-independence of 1,x,y; z=bx-ay=bu-av; the four vanishing symbols and the hypotheses needed to transport them (Y/X, V/U not in C); [u] not in F_p[x]; the exponent is well defined per vertex (fixed V as a varies; a=1 uniqueness via U) and agrees on edges, so it is constant on the connected complete multipartite graph; lines through [1] map into lines and translates handle the rest; the inverse argument with the scalar-line lemma gives r=1; equality of lines and uniqueness of n. Sec 5: projective lifting proof (affine chart, coordinatewise sigma_i, additivity/multiplicativity from parallels), uniqueness of the lift up to scalar, multiplicativity of S via uniqueness, perfect core via Eisenstein T^{p^m}-f, recovery S(k)=l, injectivity. Small cases (p=2) also consistent.
sibling_notes: The board already had a no_gap_found entry for this same dir (rank 346) from another branch. My independent check agrees, and I overwrote the entry with my own summary. The companion Bogomolov-Pop entry in family 009 is unrelated; this paper is self-contained apart from standard facts (Milnor presentation, Eisenstein criterion).
